The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 5dda4f860a38357f), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 22. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Fix c > 1, and form all parameters from x, with H fixed before x tends to infinity. For t = x or t = x/c, let K(t) = #{(τ, σ) ∈ G(t)2 : τ ̸= σ, F(τ) = F(σ)}. There is a quantity ϵH → 0, independent of the phase, such that K(t) ≤ ϵH + ox;H(1) xGm log x . The pairs counted here are ordered pairs of distinct tuples.
